description: Unsigned transactions for `wallet`: approve the factor registry, then lock(amount). It counts at once for the accounts this wallet owns. Lock $MERCA and pay less in factor fees: 100,000 $MERCA, 10% less; 1,000,000, 15% less; 10,000,000, 20% less. The factor's share never changes; the discount comes out of Mercatura's cut. Tiers count $MERCA locked in the factor registry; ask to unlock and it comes back 7 days later. These are the launch numbers; Mercatura can change them. Listing a factor needs no $MERCA.
name: merca_lock
title: $MERCA: lock it to pay less in factor fees
